problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ -4 & -1\end{aligned}],\,P=[\begin{aligned}a & b \\ c & d\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrices shown above.
Given that $A$ has the complex eigenvalue $\lambda =1+2\text{i},$ and that $A=PC{P}^{-1}$ where $C$ is a rotation-scaling matrix, what is the value of 
$\frac{{a}^{2}+{b}^{2}}{{c}^{2}+{d}^{2}}?$
